commands.notes: Listening TCP sockets and bound, unconnected UDP sockets from the kernel socket tables. Rows print COMMAND PID USER TYPE NAME (-t prints PIDs only; -n and -P are accepted, output is always numeric). This session's listeners are always listed and carry their job identity. For a named port, listeners held outside the session are listed after the host process inspection approval process_list uses; without it, stderr says those holders were not inspected. A holder the host cannot read shows its port with PID unknown. Read-only: kill and pkill still refuse processes this session did not start.

reuse.extension: Reuse the hostprocess port-holder owner behind process_list over the lineage kernel socket tables; no lsof binary, no host-global signal authority.
reuse.evidence_kind: existing operation and adjacent regression references; not new-command qualification

commands.name: timeout
commands.operands: DURATION is decimal seconds with an optional s, m, h or d suffix; 0 disables the timer. COMMAND and its arguments dispatch as a reached command: native names bind natively, other programs launch confined, each with its own receipt.
commands.encoding: Input bytes retain exact record delimiters; scalar values must be valid UTF-8 and contain no NUL.

statuses.125: timeout itself failed (missing operand, invalid interval or signal).
statuses.126: COMMAND was found but could not run.

example.kind: documented-output-example; setup defined by fixture corpus; metadata/job identities synthetic

commands.notes: Expiry sends SIGNAL (TERM by default) to the external process the command started, through program supervision, and KILL after -k; a native operation is interrupted. Status is 124 unless --preserve-status, which keeps the command's own status (128 plus the signal when a signal ended it). The command envelope's timeout_ms stays the outer bound and always wins. --foreground is accepted; program streams are never a terminal. Waiting for the supervised child or its deadline can park the command call.

reuse.extension: Dispatch prefix over the nested-command port with supervision expiry.
reuse.evidence_kind: Supervision tests with an injected clock
